deploy-bot: Starting deploy pipeline: tag v2.14.2 -> staging (commit abc1234). Change window: 15:00-16:00 PST. Steps: build → test → lint → deploy.

jamie: FYI this includes the new tokenizer fallback code. should be safe.

ci-bot: build: ✅ passed (artifact: infra-image-2026-03-19)

ci-bot: test: ✅ passed (unit + integration)

ci-bot: lint: ❌ failed

```
error: max-len  "server/runtime/streamer.py" line 412
  Line exceeds maximum length of 120. Found 189.
```

alice.h: ahhh that was from the auto-formatter update — forgot to run `yarn format` before committing.

ben.dev: don't bypass lint on release branches. Options: 1) quick format + amend and re-run, 2) pin staging to previous tag while we hotfix, 3) if it's non-blocking we can mark lint as advisory. I'd prefer option 1.

sasha_pm: +1 to not bypass. This is staging so quick format + re-run is fine. For prod we should pin.

nina_ops: change window still open, re-run allowed. jamie, can you push a formatted commit? I can re-run the pipeline once it's up.

jamie: pushed fix as commit abc1234 -> abc1234f (PR #3421). Ran `yarn format` and adjusted long fstrings.

ci-bot: lint: re-run started

ci-bot: lint: ✅ passed

deploy-bot: Pipeline complete: staging deploy succeeded. Deployed tag v2.14.2 -> staging at 2026-03-19T15:09:30Z. Instance group: staging-gpu-x3.

deploy-bot: Release notes (short): 
- tokenizer fallback resilience fixes
- runtime streaming stability improvements
- minor perf tweaks for KV cache
Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.14.2

sasha_pm: For prod we should pin to v2.14.1 until the QA pass tomorrow. Let's avoid a prod push with last-minute formatter changes.

alice.h: agree. I'll open a quick ticket to track the post-QA prod rollout and add regression tests around the long-line formatting.

nina_ops: Noted. Scheduling: prod pinned to v2.14.1, canary for v2.14.2 after 4h of staging smoke tests. I'll set the prod deploy for 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC with 30-min rollback window.

ben.dev: thanks. If staging smoke shows issues we roll back and cut v2.14.3 hotfix.

jamie: thanks folks. cc @deploy-bot :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: prod deploy (pinned v2.14.1) at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Canary window for v2.14.2 at 2026-03-19T19:30:00Z (4h after staging deploy).
